LESSON: HOUSE OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.1: House of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: House of God
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is the church a holy place?

1. appreciate the church as a house of worship

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: appreciate the church as a house of worship

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the church as a house of worship.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the church as a house of worship” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the church as a house of worship” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the church as a house of worship" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: appreciate the church as a house of worship

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: appreciate the church as a house of worship

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for House of God.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the church a holy place?
